title: Grateful Dead Live at Clark University on 1969-04-20

ai_review.summary: Outstanding 1969 recording with a stellar Dark Star and superb sound quality that captures Jerry’s fiery playing.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about the extraordinary performance, especially the transcendent Dark Star, and repeatedly praise Jerry Garcia’s guitar as being on fire. The recording is described as “outstanding” for its era, delivering crystal‑clear sound that lets the psychedelic ambience shine through.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviewers gave five stars and highlighted both exceptional musical performance (especially Jerry’s playing and Dark Star) and excellent sound quality, indicating a uniformly positive assessment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers call the sound quality “outstanding” for 1969, noting clarity and a vivid psychedelic ambience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; overall enthusiasm suggests a consistently strong performance throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for sounding great and being “on fire” during the show.
